skills.delivery_notes: piercing weapon-copy projectile along a throw axis (100% intrinsic pierce -> line). SOURCE PATH IS A BOOMERANG: outward, decelerate, RETURN through enemies, hitting on BOTH passes with ~0.3s per-enemy re-hit cooldown — the return-pass double-hit is identity-bearing and no 26-enum carries an out-and-return path; engine line pierce is one-way. Ele Buzzsaw variant: physical weapon copy scaled by flat-added elemental (added lightning + added cold + Trinity).

mapping_json.motion_frame: high-cadence walk-and-throw buzzsaw: weapon copies stream out and return while the player strafes between throws

geometry: projectile-speed shapes the turnaround distance (source behavior, noted)
economy: mana-light spend, high attack cadence (chassis default)

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Element per corpus/probe: lightning primary; water (added cold) secondary per hybrid top-2 rule; Trinity's third-element resonance dropped (crosswalks §1 triple+ rule). PoE shock rider -> sunder (§2 false-friend). Qualitative mint-candidate filed: out-and-return boomerang projectile path (graded as if un-minted).

deviation_notes: What the Ele Buzzsaw player would miss: the return pass — hitting enemies BEHIND you on the way back, the double-hit overlap zone at the deceleration point, and the stutter-step rhythm of standing inside overlapping out-and-return copies. Engine expresses a one-way piercing line only.

skills.delivery_notes: permanent independent minion entities raised at corpse position; 3-5 powerful ranged proxies spread across the combat area and fight autonomously (multi-entity footprint). Fire per the Solar Guard era-variant (corpus element); later-era spectre pools drift physical/lightning.
utility corpse-generation patch: desecrated ground spawning the corpses that fuel Raise Spectre — summon-ritual support, not a damage skill.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: The runtime loop (permanent ranged proxy army + support caster) lands on totem/proxy lanes. THE GAP: spectres are raised copies of MAP MONSTERS — the minion pool is the game's enemy roster, and each spectre RETAINS ITS NATIVE MONSTER ABILITIES ('Raise permanent copy of map monster'). Engine proxies are kit-generated content; there is no world-entity-capture or monster-ability-inheritance lane. Docket filed (batch flag e applied).

deviation_notes: Player test fails: hand a Spectre Necromancer a fixed generic minion squad and they say 'this is a summoner, but this is not Spectres.' The defining identity — choosing WHICH world monster to enslave (Solar Guards vs Slave Drivers vs Syndicate Operatives) and inheriting its ability kit — has no engine mechanism class.
